indication_area: Sleep medicine (cataplexy or excessive daytime sleepiness in narcolepsy)
formulation: extended-release oral suspension (granules for once-nightly dosing)

launch_evidence.quote: In June 2023, the Company commercially launched LUMRYZ in the U.S for the treatment of cataplexy or EDS in adults living with narcolepsy.
